items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: It was Jimmy Rogers. I played with him.

ctx.x: Oh, that was another Zito. That wasn't the same one. Oh, yeah. He was a guitar player. He played out the beach for a whole season out there. And then went around. So I hit the road again. I couldn't make money here, so I had to hit the road again. So I joined a couple of, we used to call them turkeys in them days, these tent shows. I think this one here. That's a Hollywood scandal. Yeah, yeah. It was a presentation show. But I've had him on here somewhere. Well, it was Jimmy Rogers. I played with him. I don't…
